purpose: Verify that the corrected reconstructed-tile WCS used by admitted C0 can be reproduced from the named full-plate FITS header, deterministic 7x7 tile geometry, and frozen per-plate CRPIX table without reading any tile image pixels. Admission would remove 60-arcmin tile pixel transport from subsequent morphology scaleout localization.

frozen_sample.truth: C0 sidecar pred_x0/pred_y0 and local_pixel_scale_arcsec, which were produced from corrected reconstructed tile FITS headers after sparse 60-arcmin section transport.

header_only_method.plate_identity: Use the exact frozen tile_id -> named POSS-I plate_id mapping.
header_only_method.remote_access: Open named dss1red_{plate}.fits with lazy/fsspec header access; never access hdu.section or hdu.data.
header_only_method.tile_grid: Recompute the same 7x7 pixel-space centres from NAXIS1/NAXIS2, XPIXELSZ, PLTSCALE and 60-arcmin tile size.
header_only_method.tile_identity: Regenerate format_tile_id at each grid centre and require exact frozen tile_id membership.
header_only_method.section_geometry: Compute overlap_slices only; do not materialize the section array.
header_only_method.tile_wcs: Use the same clean_tan_header_from_full function and same frozen plate_crpix_table.csv correction as B2/C0.
header_only_method.prediction: Transform frozen S0 ra/dec with the header-only corrected tile WCS.

predeclared_gates.plate_header_access: All named plates required by the 64-source sample must yield valid headers/WCS.
predeclared_gates.tile_identity: All 52 frozen distinct tile_ids must be regenerated exactly.
predeclared_gates.prediction_coverage: 64/64 sources must obtain finite header-only x/y predictions.
predeclared_gates.equivalence_primary: 64/64 sources must agree with frozen C0 pred_x0/pred_y0 to Euclidean <= 1e-6 pixel.
predeclared_gates.pixel_scale_equivalence: 64/64 local pixel-scale values must agree with C0 to absolute <= 1e-9 arcsec/pixel.
predeclared_gates.pixel_transport: No hdu.section, .data or array materialization from remote plate pixels is permitted.
